auth.logoutConfirm: Do you really want to log out?
auth.profileMissing: Your account exists but there is no profile row (often after an incomplete first signup). In Supabase: Authentication → delete this user and sign up again; or add the row manually in the "profiles" table.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Your session is not active yet. Open the confirmation link in the email from Supabase, then try signing in again.
auth.invalidSupabaseKey: The Supabase API key does not match your project. In the Supabase dashboard: Project Settings → API, copy the anon public key (long JWT), put it in ExpenseApp/.env as EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=… and set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL to your project URL. Restart npm run dev.
auth.requestTimeout: Sign-in took too long (network or server). Reload the page and try again.
auth.fillAllFields: Please fill in first name, last name, email and password.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.
auth.popupIncompleteBody: Please enter your first name, last name, email address and password to continue.
auth.popupPasswordBody: Your password must be at least 6 characters long. Please choose a longer one.
auth.popupEmailExistsBody: An account is already linked to this email. Sign in or use a different email address.
auth.popupLoginIncompleteBody: Please enter your email address and password.

employee.title: My Expenses
employee.analysisFailed: Analysis failed. Please fill in manually.
employee.noExpensesDesc: Scan a receipt to get started
employee.receiptAttachedHint: Tap to view or replace the receipt

expense.vatAutoExplanation: Enter the net (HT) and gross (incl. tax) amounts from the receipt: VAT (gross − net), the net base and an equivalent overall rate are calculated automatically.
expense.ttcLessThanHt: The gross amount must be greater than or equal to the net amount.
expense.otherExplainHint: State what the expense is for (required for “Other”).
expense.otherExplainPlaceholder: E.g. office supplies, bank fees, subscription…
expense.otherExplainRequired: Please describe the expense when you choose “Other”.
expense.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Delete this expense entry?
expense.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Only “pending” expenses can be removed; approved or rejected ones stay on record.
expense.receiptLoadError: Could not load the receipt image. Check Supabase Storage policies or the file link.
expense.noReceiptAttached: No receipt image for this expense
expense.receiptRequired: Add a photo or image of the receipt (camera or gallery) before saving this expense.
expense.uploadReceiptFailed: Uploading the receipt to storage failed (Supabase permissions, network, or format). The expense was not saved. Try again or check the console.
expense.vatRowHtSum: Net total = sum of VAT bases
expense.vatSubmitBlocked: Amounts don’t match the VAT breakdown. Check each line (multi-rate receipts) or update gross.
expense.vatHintMultiRate: If the receipt has several VAT rates, add one row per rate and enter base and VAT as printed.
expense.vatApplyComputedHt: Set net total to {{amount}} (sum of bases)

alerts.duplicateMessage: A similar expense already exists (same date, supplier and amount). Do you want to continue?
alerts.fiscalMessage: The total amount exceeds {{threshold}}€. A detailed receipt is required.
alerts.cameraPermissionMsg: The app needs camera access to scan receipts.

admin.exportShareUnavailable: File sharing isn't available on this device. Try exporting from the web (download) or use another app.
admin.dateRangeHint: Tap the start day, then the end day. For a single day, confirm after the first tap.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: You’ll see updates for new expenses, pending changes, and when your submissions are approved or rejected.
notifications.expenseUnavailableBody: This expense no longer exists or you don’t have access to it.
